question: I run a goods-only trading business in Pune, Maharashtra and sell only within Maharashtra. My total turnover in the last financial year was Rs 42,00,000. Do I have to register for GST? Answer yes or no.
I sell only goods, all within Telangana, from Hyderabad. My turnover last financial year was Rs 30,00,000. Is GST registration mandatory for me? Answer yes or no.
I run a goods-only shop in Imphal, Manipur and sell only within Manipur. My turnover last financial year was Rs 15,00,000. Do I need to register for GST? Answer yes or no.
I sell only goods, all within Assam, from Guwahati. My turnover last financial year was Rs 30,00,000. Is GST registration mandatory? Answer yes or no.
I am a consultant providing only services from Dehradun, Uttarakhand, to clients within Uttarakhand. My turnover last financial year was Rs 15,00,000. Must I register for GST? Answer yes or no.
I am a goods trader in Delhi with a turnover of Rs 15,00,000 last financial year. I sometimes ship goods to customers in Punjab (inter-State). Do I have to register for GST? Answer yes or no.
I am a garment trader in Bengaluru, Karnataka selling only goods within Karnataka, with a turnover of Rs 1,20,00,000 last financial year. Can I opt for the GST composition scheme? Answer yes or no.
I am a garment trader in Gangtok, Sikkim, selling only goods within Sikkim, with a turnover of Rs 90,00,000 last financial year. Can I opt for the GST composition scheme? Answer yes or no.
My company's aggregate turnover in the previous financial year was Rs 5.2 crore. Is e-invoicing mandatory for us under GST from 2026? Answer yes or no.
My company's aggregate turnover in the previous financial year was exactly Rs 5,00,00,000 (Rs 5 crore). Is e-invoicing mandatory for us under GST in 2026? Answer yes or no.
My business had a turnover of Rs 8 crore last financial year. How many digits of HSN code must I show on my B2B tax invoices (from 1 April 2021 onwards)? Give a number.
What was the GST rate (CGST+SGST/IGST combined, excluding cess) on Portland cement, HSN 252329, on 21 September 2025? Give a percentage.
What is the GST rate (combined, excluding cess) on Portland cement, HSN 252329, on 22 September 2025? Give a percentage.
What is the GST rate on toilet soap in bars (HSN 340111) on 10 January 2026? Give a percentage.
What is the GST rate on rice that is sold pre-packaged and labelled (HSN 100630) on 1 March 2026? Give a percentage.
What is the GST rate on vegetables preserved otherwise than by vinegar and not frozen (HSN 200599, e.g. canned mixed vegetables) on 1 February 2026? Give a percentage.
What is the GST rate (excluding any cess) on a petrol SUV with a 2,500 cc engine and length over 4 metres, HSN 870323, on 1 February 2026? Give a percentage.
What is the GST rate on filter cigarettes (HSN 240220) on 1 March 2026? Give a percentage for GST only, not cess or excise.
A Mumbai (Maharashtra) manufacturer sells Portland cement (HSN 252329) worth Rs 1,00,000 to a buyer in Pune (Maharashtra) on 15 January 2026. How much CGST is charged? Give rupees.
A Mumbai (Maharashtra) manufacturer sells Portland cement (HSN 252329) worth Rs 1,00,000 to a buyer in Bengaluru (Karnataka) on 15 January 2026. How much IGST is charged? Give rupees.

A Delhi IT reseller invoices 5 laptops (HSN 8471) at Rs 50,000 each to a company in Haryana on 10 February 2026, with a Rs 10,000 trade discount shown on the invoice itself. How much IGST is payable on the invoice? Give rupees.

A dealer in Nashik, Maharashtra sells a 150 cc motorcycle (HSN 871120) for Rs 1,00,000 (before tax) to a customer in Nashik on 1 June 2025. What is the total GST including any compensation cess? Give rupees.

A GST-registered manufacturing company in Mumbai, Maharashtra pays an individual advocate in Mumbai Rs 1,00,000 for legal advice (SAC 998212) on 20 January 2026. Under reverse charge, how much GST must the company itself pay to the government? Give rupees.

A GST-registered factory in Pune, Maharashtra pays a goods transport agency (GTA) Rs 50,000 freight for road transport of goods on 20 January 2026. The GTA charges no GST on the invoice because it has not opted for the 18% (with ITC) rate. At the 5% rate, how much GST must the factory pay under reverse charge? Give rupees.

Our trading company bought a passenger car (HSN 8703, seating 5) for the managing director's use. The supplier invoice (GST Rs 1,20,000) appears in both our purchase register and GSTR-2B. The car is not used for resale, passenger transport or driving training. How much input tax credit can we claim on it? Give rupees.

A transport company bought a new goods carrier truck (HSN 8704) for carrying goods. The supplier invoice (GST Rs 2,80,000) appears in both our purchase register and GSTR-2B. How much input tax credit can we claim on it? Give rupees.

Our software company paid a restaurant caterer (SAC 996331) for a staff party. The invoice (GST Rs 9,000) is in both our books and GSTR-2B. We do not sell food, and no law obliges us to provide it. How much input tax credit can we claim? Give rupees.
I am a regular monthly filer in Gujarat with turnover above Rs 5 crore. What is the due date for the GSTR-3B for October 2026? Give a date.
I am a QRMP (quarterly) filer in Maharashtra. What is the due date for the quarterly GSTR-1 for April-June 2026? Give a date.
I am a QRMP (quarterly) filer with my principal place of business in Maharashtra. What is the due date for the GSTR-3B for April-June 2026? Give a date.
I am a QRMP (quarterly) filer with my principal place of business in Delhi. What is the due date for the GSTR-3B for April-June 2026? Give a date.
I am a QRMP (quarterly) filer with my principal place of business in Kerala. What is the due date for the GSTR-3B for April-June 2026? Give a date.
I am a QRMP (quarterly) filer. By what date can I upload invoices for April 2026 (the first month of the quarter) using the Invoice Furnishing Facility (IFF)? Give a date.
I am a QRMP (quarterly) filer. Can I use the Invoice Furnishing Facility (IFF) for June 2026, the third month of the quarter? Answer yes or no.

In October 2026 my Maharashtra firm sold goods to an unregistered individual in Karnataka for Rs 1,50,000 plus 18% IGST (Rs 27,000). Must this invoice be reported invoice-by-invoice in GSTR-1 Table 5 (B2C Large) rather than being clubbed into the B2C-others table? Answer yes or no.

I run a trading business (not a profession) and my FY 2025-26 turnover was Rs 2.8 crore, with 97% of receipts through bank transfers/UPI and only 3% in cash. Can I use presumptive taxation under section 44AD? Answer yes or no.
I run a trading business and my FY 2025-26 turnover was Rs 2.5 crore, but 20% of my receipts were in cash. Can I use presumptive taxation under section 44AD? Answer yes or no.
I am a practising doctor (individual) with FY 2025-26 gross receipts of Rs 60 lakh, 98% received digitally. Can I use presumptive taxation under section 44ADA? Answer yes or no.

I am a salaried employee with gross salary of Rs 18,00,000 in FY 2025-26 and no other income or deductions. Under the new tax regime (with the Rs 75,000 standard deduction), what is my total tax including 4% cess? Give rupees.

I am a salaried employee with gross salary of Rs 12,80,000 in FY 2025-26 and no other income or deductions. Under the new tax regime (Rs 75,000 standard deduction), what is my total tax including 4% cess? Give rupees.

I am a chartered engineer in Pune providing only consulting services to clients in Maharashtra. My turnover last financial year was Rs 30,00,000. If I opt for the GST composition scheme, what is the maximum preceding-year turnover allowed for my scheme, in rupees? Answer with a number.

I am a consultant in Pune providing only services within Maharashtra, turnover Rs 30,00,000 last financial year. Under the composition scheme for service providers, what total GST rate (CGST plus SGST) do I pay on my turnover? Answer with a percentage.

I run an interior design consultancy in Bengaluru, Karnataka, services only, all clients within Karnataka. Turnover last financial year was Rs 55,00,000. Can I opt for the GST composition scheme? Answer yes or no.

I am a software consultant in Pune with Rs 30,00,000 turnover last financial year, services only. Some of my clients are in Karnataka and Gujarat. Can I opt for the 6% composition scheme for service providers? Answer yes or no.

I offer home-cleaning services in Mumbai, all booked through an app that collects TCS under section 52. Turnover last financial year was Rs 25,00,000, services only, all within Maharashtra. Can I opt for the GST composition scheme? Answer yes or no.

I run a shop in Nagpur, Maharashtra. Last financial year I sold Rs 20,00,000 of goods, including pan masala (HSN 2106 90 20), and earned Rs 20,00,000 from repair services, all within Maharashtra. Can I opt for the 6% composition scheme? Answer yes or no.

I trade goods in Pune, all within Maharashtra: Rs 40,00,000 of goods and Rs 4,50,000 of installation services last financial year. Which composition route applies to me: the regular scheme under section 10(1) or the services scheme under section 10(2A)? Answer s10_1 or s10_2A.
